info.title: Indonesian Stock Analysis API
info.description:
Production-grade realtime and historical analysis API for Indonesian (IDX) equities.

All `/api/v1` data endpoints require authentication (`X-API-Key` header or `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`) **and** an allow-listed browser origin. Responses use a uniform `{meta, data}` envelope; errors use a uniform `{error}` envelope.

get.summary: Realtime quote for an IDX symbol
Composite trading signal with confidence and risk
Aggregate snapshot of the tracked IDX universe
Symbols trading on unusually high relative volume
Full fundamental snapshot (valuation, profitability, health, growth)
Compare headline fundamentals across multiple symbols
